name: 2N7002 60V 115mA N-MOSFET SOT-23 C8545
label: 2N7002
source: JLCPCB and LCSC part records, read 2026-11-01 ; datasheet:https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/a141b8bd86b14475955ac8c4d3eea0a8.pdf
notes: Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.. JLCPCB lists 1 N-channel 115mA 2.5V 225mW 25pF 50pF 5pF 5Ω@10V 60V N-Channel ±20V SOT-23 MOSFETs ROHS. Basic. | LCSC cross-check: model=2N7002 pkg=SOT-23 brand=JSCJ // Datasheet (Ta = 25 C): VDS 60 V, continuous ID 0.115 A, VGS +/- 20 V, VGS(th) 1 V minimum to 2.5 V maximum at 250 uA. on_resistance is the largest RDS(on) maximum of the table, 7 ohm at VGS = 5 V and 50 mA (5 ohm at 10 V and 500 mA, which is what JLCPCB lists), so it holds for a drive of 5 V or more and not for a lower one. Datasheet JSCJ 2N7002 (footer J,Sep,2016), p.2 "MOSFET ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS" table: RDS(on) 1.1 ohm typ and 7 ohm max at VGS = 5 V, ID = 50 mA (0.9 ohm typ and 5 ohm max at VGS = 10 V, ID = 500 mA). on_resistance_vgs is that test gate-source voltage (ADR 0092), so a design that drives the gate with less than 5 V is refused.

name: AO3400A 30V 5.7A N-MOSFET SOT-23 C20917

notes: Alpha & Omega Semicon. JLCPCB lists -55℃~+150℃ 1 N-channel 1.45V 1.4W 30V 48mΩ@2.5V 5.7A 50pF 630pF 75pF 7nC@10V N-Channel SOT-23 MOSFETs ROHS. Basic. | LCSC cross-check: model=AO3400A pkg=SOT-23 brand=AOS // Datasheet (TA = 25 C): VDS 30 V, continuous ID 5.7 A, VGS +/- 12 V, VGS(th) 0.65 V minimum to 1.45 V maximum at 250 uA. on_resistance is the largest RDS(on) maximum of the table, 48 mohm at VGS = 2.5 V and 3 A (32 mohm at 4.5 V, 26.5 mohm at 10 V), so it holds for a drive of 2.5 V or more. Datasheet AOS AO3400A Rev 3 December 2011, p.2 "Electrical Characteristics" table: RDS(ON) 24 mohm typ and 48 mohm max at VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 3 A (32 mohm max at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 5 A; 26.5 mohm max at VGS = 10 V, ID = 5.7 A). on_resistance_vgs is that test gate-source voltage (ADR 0092).
